thread:
Asha (Sec): Heads-up: mandatory security change coming — long-lived service keys are being deprecated. All internal services and CI must migrate to OIDC short-lived tokens or Vault-rotated machine creds by 2026-04-15. Read the migration guidance and act.
Tom (Infra): Clarify scope: dev/stage/prod?
Asha (Sec): All environments. We will allow documented exceptions for non-prod short-term only; prod must be migrated by the deadline.
Priya (DevEx): Where's the runbook? Can we get examples for k8s, VM services, and CI?
Marta (Platform): Draft runbook is in internal docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/oidc-migration. Summary: create workload identity, update service account / deployment annotations, adapt CI to request OIDC tokens or use Vault short-lived creds, validate.
Tom (Infra): Example k8s snippet:
```
# annotate SA for workload identity
kubectl annotate serviceaccount my-app iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account=project-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# verify token usage
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /var/run/secrets/tokens/oidc)" https://internal-api/health
```
Priya (DevEx): I'll build a small CLI validator to check token issuance + call a health endpoint. Can add to quickstart templates.
Asha (Sec): Please do. Open PR to infra/tools and tag SEC-4239.
Tom (Infra): CI question: we have ~12 pipelines using static deploy tokens. Will need conversion plan.
Asha (Sec): All pipelines must move to ephemeral OIDC tokens or Vault-managed short-lived machine tokens with auto-rotation. We've inventoried pipelines under SEC-4239.
sre-oncall: If a mass rollout causes failures, what's the rollback path?
Marta (Platform): Emergency rollback: re-enable legacy key only via a time-boxed, audited emergency token flow. sec-bot will log the event. This requires approval from Sec oncall and infra lead.
sec-bot: Scheduled scans: weekly key-leak and token-usage reports. Initial inventory running, results will post here.
Asha (Sec): Action checklist: 1) owners update service configs to use OIDC by 2026-04-15. 2) update CI to request tokens or use Vault short-lived creds. 3) run validation script and paste output into SEC-4239 ticket. 4) request exception if migration is impossible (must include mitigation and timeline).
Priya (DevEx): ETA for CLI helper?
Priya (DevEx): EOW for initial PR, follow-on improvements next sprint.
Tom (Infra): I'll start with core infra services and enumerate owners on the ticket.
sre-oncall: I'll keep an eye on alerts during rollouts and have an incident channel ready.
Marta (Platform): Scheduling migration office hours Tuesday 10am PT — will share calendar invite.
Asha (Sec): Noncompliance after the deadline will trigger automated key revocation and a security review. Tag me with questions or join office hours. :lock:
